g.text: Manually routed. Not a field-installation release.

g.desc: Manually routed. Not a field-installation release.

g.text: 1. GPS TX(5) -> GPIO20 RX; GPIO21 TX -> GPS RX(4). Use UART0 for GPS and native USB for logs.

g.desc: 1. GPS TX(5) -> GPIO20 RX; GPIO21 TX -> GPS RX(4). Use UART0 for GPS and native USB for logs.

g.text: 2. SW201 is a firmware request. GPIO2/8/9 stay unloaded; signal safety remains with the coordinator.

g.desc: 2. SW201 is a firmware request. GPIO2/8/9 stay unloaded; signal safety remains with the coordinator.

g.text: 3. Use regulated 5 V USB from a bench or protected vehicle adapter. Keep raw 12/24 V outside this circuit.

g.desc: 3. Use regulated 5 V USB from a bench or protected vehicle adapter. Keep raw 12/24 V outside this circuit.

g.text: PROPOSED GPS: Adafruit Ultimate GPS v3 #746. Power through U201 onboard USB-C only (regulated 5 V USB).

g.desc: PROPOSED GPS: Adafruit Ultimate GPS v3 #746. Power through U201 onboard USB-C only (regulated 5 V USB).

g.text: P1 - PROTOTYPE REVIEW | header labels identify modules; IC pad numbers identify bare parts.

g.desc: P1 - PROTOTYPE REVIEW | header labels identify modules; IC pad numbers identify bare parts.

g.text: ESP-NOW uses the onboard 2.4 GHz antenna; no LoRa module is needed on this beacon.

g.desc: ESP-NOW uses the onboard 2.4 GHz antenna; no LoRa module is needed on this beacon.

g.text: GPS EN is already pulled up on the carrier; optional backup cell and unused outputs are left open.

g.desc: GPS EN is already pulled up on the carrier; optional backup cell and unused outputs are left open.
